hero.intro: I build soft, tactile digital experiences — from pixel-perfect React interfaces to robust Python, Flask & SQLAlchemy backends. Neat code, softer shadows.

about.bio1: I'm a full-stack developer from Pakistan with 3 years of hands-on experience shipping web applications end-to-end. My playground stretches from HTML & CSS fundamentals to modern React frontends and Python-powered backends.
about.bio2: Off the editor, I run BantaTech — a YouTube channel where I break down web development for the next wave of builders. Code, cameras, and constant learning.

services.title: Frontend Engineering
services.text: Responsive, component-driven React interfaces with buttery interactions and pixel-perfect detail.

services.title: Backend & APIs
services.text: Clean REST services with Python, Flask and SQLAlchemy — modeled data, auth, and solid architecture.

services.title: Content & Community
services.text: Sharing the craft on YouTube @bantatech — tutorials, builds, and the journey of shipping products.

skills.sub: A carefully sharpened stack for building complete products — from the first wireframe to the deployed API.

experience.sub: Every year, a new layer of the stack — pressed into a timeline.

items.text: Fell in love with the browser. Built responsive interfaces with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, then leveled up to React — shipping 10+ landing pages and dashboards.
Moved behind the scenes. Designed REST APIs with Flask, modeled data with SQLAlchemy, and wired up SQL databases with authentication and migrations.
Connecting both worlds into complete products — and teaching the craft on YouTube @bantatech while building in public with VS Code as my home base.

contact.sub: Open for freelance projects, collaborations, or just a good tech conversation. Pick a channel — they're all soft to the touch.

footer.tagline: Crafted with pure CSS shadows, React, and an unreasonable love for soft surfaces.
